comparison.counterfactual_note: Arithmetic only, not measured RF capacity or a proposal to disable diagnostic logs; all scientific frames require3D notifications.
comparison.causality_limit: Different boots/firmware image and substantially different ADC CRC/retry/debug load. Confirmed7.5ms negotiation did not meet throughput target, but decline cannot be assigned causally to interval alone.

confirmed_findings: Actual address-matched negotiated interval is6 before/after screen04, versus12 in screen03; MTU247 and2MPHY remain known, DLE251 observed but callback peer identity unknown.

First major rejected-admission layer remains BLE four DATA slots held through complete three-fragment sends. BL50 dropD+3852 vs+3440; transport queueDrop+225 vs+236. Different diagnostic/query windows are retained, not summed as exact capture loss.
No fragment error/congestion/stale or host reassembly CRC/identity errors observed; these zeros do not prove absence of credit starvation or RF retransmission.
Average SDK bracket grows modestly; most aggregate extra time per completed call is outside the SDK bracket. Aggregate does not identify which task or lock consumed it.

WorkBudget active reasons are elapsed quantum and no-idle backstop, never32unit bound. BLE yields increase while service calls fall; callback-time and wall statistics alone cannot prove the scheduler guard is the root cause.
LOG notification rate is essentially unchanged. At observed total notification service, redirecting every LOG notification to DATA would still be far below capture demand.
screen04 ADC CRC and debug line load differ from screen03. Debug workload is a confounder requiring measurement, not grounds to suppress errors.

next_minimal_observation.recommended: One bounded observation-only candidate before another blind priority/queue/budget change.

credit_sampling.location: same BLE-owner Core0, one known live connection; sample around actual SDK calls or sparsely per descriptor
credit_sampling.meaning: transient LE controller HCI transmit window, not PC receipt or per-event capacity
credit_sampling.avoid: per-connection getter in hot path; it takes portMAX_DELAY buffer semaphore in local IDF

work_budget_elapsed.location: around the existing vTaskDelay(1), without changing due predicates or thresholds
work_budget_elapsed.fields: per-worker requestedYieldCount, elapsedYieldUs modulo32, maxElapsedYieldUs; existing reasons retained
work_budget_elapsed.meaning: actual unavailable wall time including wakeup scheduling; not CPU time. Combined with SDK bracket distinguishes deliberate delay/reschedule from remaining outside-call processing.

next_minimal_observation.if_still_ambiguous: Enable optional IDF task runtime statistics for a separate diagnostic image and take coarse task snapshots outside capture (BLE owner/BTC/BTU/controller/AsyncLog/Serial/Transport/IDLE0); current CONFIG_FREERTOS_GENERATE_RUN_TIME_STATS and TRACE_FACILITY are off. Do not substitute cycle-counter wall deltas for task CPU time.
decision_rule: If credits are frequently0 and later recover, inspect actual HCI completed-packet cadence/central event budget; GATT congestion0 is not contrary proof.
If credits remain available and SDK/wakeup wall dominates, measure task CPU scheduling before changing the conservative idle guard.
A service-budget fix must preserve real IDLE0 progress and bounded no-host control; do not raise queue depth, eliminate watchdog, or cap capture.
